items.text: they reply to every text with a voice note
still uses the ringtone they had in 2014
thinks cereal counts as a soup
has never finished a series they started
says "we should hang out" and means it every single time
alphabetises their spice rack
cannot whistle but insists they can
takes a photo of every meal before the first bite
knows all the lyrics to songs but never the title
reads the last page of a book first
keeps every receipt since 2011
pronounces gif with a hard G on purpose
has a playlist called Songs for Later with 900 songs in it
waves back at people who were not waving at them
wears socks with sandals in every season
buys a new plant every month and keeps none alive
starts every email with an apology, even the good news ones
collects a keyring from every city they visit
always orders something other than their favourite dish
can name every country in the world but not find their keys
says "I'll be quick" and then talks for an hour
has read the terms and conditions, for fun
eats the best bit of the pizza first
checks the weather forecast every hour and is never right
leaves the group chat on read for three days
fixes everything by turning it off and on again
has a desktop folder called New Folder (3)
brings a water bottle to the gym and never opens it
says they don't need a holiday and then books three
sings in the shower with total confidence
always knows where the nearest toilet is
loves rain, but only when they are indoors
says they are always on time, then arrives after the friend who is late
carries a pen in every bag and none of them work
reads every sign in the lift out loud
